universe.title: 007 Universe
universe.description: The 007 universe is set in the modern era of international espionage, featuring British secret agent James Bond and his missions for Her Majesty's Secret Intelligence Service (MI6). The world is one of shadowy organizations, megalomaniacal villains, and high-stakes operations that threaten global security.
source_material: James Bond novels by Ian Fleming (1953-1964)

mi6.name: Her Majesty's Secret Intelligence Service
mi6.description: MI6, also known as the Secret Intelligence Service (SIS), is the foreign intelligence agency of the United Kingdom. Responsible for gathering human intelligence (HUMINT) overseas to protect British national security interests.

c.title: Chief of the Secret Intelligence Service
c.description: The head of MI6, commonly referred to as 'M' in Bond lore. Responsible for overall strategy and operations.

q_branch.title: Quartermaster Branch
q_branch.description: The technical branch of MI6 responsible for providing gadgets, weapons, and equipment to field agents.
famous_gadgets: Aston Martin DB5 with ejector seat, missiles, and bulletproof shield

moneypenny.title: M's Personal Assistant
moneypenny.description: M's personal assistant and head of personnel at MI6 Headquarters. Often the first point of contact for agents returning from missions.

field_agents.description: Operatives who conduct field operations, including surveillance, infiltration, and direct action.

00_section.description: The most elite section of MI6, consisting of license-to-kill agents. These agents are authorized to use lethal force in the field as a primary option.
00_section.numbering: Agents are numbered sequentially, with lower numbers indicating seniority and more kills.

operations.description: MI6 conducts a wide range of operations to protect British interests abroad.

james_bond.name: James Bond
james_bond.description: The most famous MI6 field agent, known for his sophistication, bravery, and ability to complete impossible missions. Bond is a product of British intelligence training with a personal code of honor.

background.education: Eton College, University of Leiden (Dutch Literature)
background.military_service: British Naval Intelligence, SOE (Special Operations Executive)

preferences: Drinks: Vodka Martini, shaken not stirred

notable_missions.name: Casino Royale
notable_missions.description: Bond's first mission as a 00 agent. Tasked with bankrupting Le Chiffre, a financier terror funding terrorism.
notable_missions.outcome: Success, but Le Chiffre's death and Vesper Lynd's betrayal haunt Bond
notable_missions.significance: Established Bond as a 00 agent and set the tone for his emotional scars

notable_missions.name: Quantum of Solace
notable_missions.description: Bond pursues revenge for Vesper Lynd's death, uncovering a conspiracy involving Quantum.
notable_missions.outcome: Quantum disrupted, but the conspiracy runs deeper
notable_missions.significance: Bond's transition from personal revenge to professional duty

notable_missions.name: Skyfall
notable_missions.description: Bond's past catches up with him as a terrorist attack on MI6 threatens the agency's existence.
notable_missions.outcome: Bond saves M and MI6, but at great personal cost
notable_missions.significance: Bond's loyalty to M and MI6 is reaffirmed

notable_missions.name: Spectre
notable_missions.description: Bond uncovers SPECTRE, a shadowy organization orchestrating global terrorism.
notable_missions.outcome: SPECTRE exposed, but Erich Krieger escapes
notable_missions.significance: Reestablished SPECTRE as the primary antagonist organization

notable_missions.name: No Time to Die
notable_missions.description: Bond is drawn out of retirement to help MI6 track down a missing scientist and his dangerous creation.
notable_missions.outcome: Bond sacrifices himself to save the world
notable_missions.significance: The end of an era for James Bond

spectre.name: SPECTRE
spectre.full_name: Special Executive for Counter-intelligence, Terrorism, Revenge, and Extortion
spectre.description: A shadowy international terrorist organization dedicated to world domination through fear and chaos. SPECTRE operates outside national boundaries, using mercenaries, spies, and advanced technology.

structure.executive_committee: Council of powerful individuals from various nations
structure.technicians: Scientists and engineers who develop weapons and technology

notable_leaders.name: Ernst Stavro Blofeld
notable_leaders.role: Original SPECTRE leader, appears in multiple Bond films

notable_leaders.name: Erich Krieger
notable_leaders.role: Modern SPECTRE leader, former CIA and other intelligence agencies
notable_leaders.characteristics: Master of manipulation and psychological warfare

quantum.name: Quantum
quantum.description: A private military contractor and intelligence agency that operates in the shadows, manipulating world events for profit and power.

structure.operations: Covert action, assassination, and intelligence gathering

notable_members: Dominic Greene - Real estate developer and front man

smersh.name: SMERSH
smersh.description: A Soviet counter-intelligence organization that appears in the early Bond novels. SMERSH is dedicated to eliminating spies and protecting Soviet secrets.

notable_operations: Operation Grand Slam - Attempt to assassinate Bond
Various counter-espionage operations in the West

scorpion.name: S.C.O.R.P.I.N.E.
scorpion.description: A cyber-terrorist organization that appears in No Time to Die, led by Lyutsifer Safin.

leader.name: Lyutsifer Safin
leader.background: Son of a Russian spy who was killed by Bond. Seeking revenge against Bond and the world.

weapon.name: Heracles
weapon.description: A bioweapon capable of targeting specific DNA profiles, potentially wiping out entire populations.
weapon.creator: Valdo Obruchev, Russian scientist

cia.name: Central Intelligence Agency
cia.description: The primary intelligence agency of the United States. MI6 and CIA have a complex relationship, sometimes cooperating and sometimes competing.
notable_agents: Felix Leiter - Long-time ally of Bond
Max Denicourt - CIA operative (antagonist in some missions)

interpol.name: International Criminal Police Organization
interpol.description: International police organization that coordinates cross-border law enforcement. Sometimes cooperates with MI6 on high-profile cases.
notable_agents: Mathis - Interpol agent and ally of Bond

mi5.name: Military Intelligence, Section 5
mi5.description: The domestic intelligence agency of the United Kingdom. MI5 handles internal security while MI6 handles foreign intelligence.
mi5.relationship: Cooperates with MI6 on matters of national security

gchq.name: Government Communications Headquarters
gchq.description: The United Kingdom's signals intelligence and cybersecurity agency. GCHQ provides technical support to MI6 operations.
gchq.relationship: Provides signals intelligence (SIGINT) support to MI6

standard_issue.description: Standard weapons and equipment issued to 00 section agents.
items: Walther PPK / SIG Sauer P320 - Standard sidearm
Tracking devices - For surveillance and asset location
Explosives - Various types for demolition and sabotage
Communication devices - Encrypted radios and phones

q_branch_gadgets.description: Specialized gadgets developed by Q Branch for specific missions.

villain_weapons.description: Advanced weapons and technology developed by villain organizations.

examples.name: Laser Satellite
examples.description: Orbital laser weapon capable of destroying targets from space

examples.name: Heracles Bioweapon
examples.description: DNA-targeted bioweapon capable of selective genocide

examples.name: Goldeneye Computer Virus
examples.description: Cyber weapon capable of hacking satellite systems

examples.name: Quantum of Solace Diamond
examples.description: Rare diamond used as a symbol of power and control

key_locations.name: MI6 Headquarters
key_locations.description: The headquarters of MI6, home to M, Q Branch, and Moneypenny.
key_locations.significance: Central command for all MI6 operations

key_locations.name: Casino Royale
key_locations.description: Famous casino where Bond played poker against Le Chiffre.

key_locations.name: Skyfall Lodge
key_locations.description: Bond's childhood home, site of the final battle in Skyfall.
key_locations.significance: Bond's connection to his past and loyalty to Britain

key_locations.name: SPECTRE Headquarters
key_locations.description: The mobile headquarters of SPECTRE, often hidden in remote locations.

key_locations.name: Interpol Headquarters
key_locations.description: Headquarters of Interpol, where international law enforcement coordinates.

key_locations.name: CIA Headquarters
key_locations.description: Headquarters of the CIA, where Felix Leiter operates.

themes.loyalty: Bond's unwavering loyalty to Britain and MI6, despite personal cost
themes.revenge: Personal vendettas drive many of Bond's missions
themes.betrayal: Trust is a luxury in the world of espionage
themes.sacrifice: Bond is willing to sacrifice everything for his country
themes.identity: The question of who Bond really is beneath the 00 facade
themes.modern_espionage: The evolving nature of intelligence work in the modern era
